response.original_title: How Do I Add a Room to an Existing Norwegian Cruise Reservation?
response.overview: [Official Resource] How Do I Add a Room to an Existing Norwegian Cruise Reservation?  To add an extra room to an existing Norwegian Cruise Line (NCL) reservation, you must contact Norwegian Cruise Line directly by phone at +1-866-259-1002 (US) or reach out to your original travel advisor, as new staterooms cannot be added online through the NCL website or app. Steps to Add a Room Call +1-866-259-1002 (US) NCL Support: Dial Norwegian Cruise Line Customer Service at +1-866-259-1002 (US) or contact your travel agent. Have Details Ready: Provide your existing reservation number, ship name, sailing date, and details for the guests who will occupy the new room +1-866-259-1002 (US).
